axis: +X runs southeast from the north rail approach and modern roof to the hotel and Euston Road; +Z faces the British Library side.
limitations: The station and adjoining hotel footprints and the platform edges come from PMTiles. The Barlow roof heights, rail level, Gothic frontage and towers are reconstructed from exterior and train-shed photographs, with standard terrain for street contact.

Visible platforms and station elevator volumes are represented. Track centerlines are estimated between mapped platform edges. Hotel interiors and operations below the raised station deck are outside the reconstruction.
